name: Arjun Mehta
bio: Final year CS student obsessed with building IoT products. I rent out my lab gear when I'm not using it.
story: Started with Arduino in Sem 3, built a smart irrigation system that won our college hackathon. Now I help juniors with embedded systems and rent out my Arduino kits during semester breaks.

name: Priya Sharma
bio: IT student who loves designing interfaces and capturing moments. Available for photography mentoring on weekends.
story: Picked up a DSLR in Sem 2 and never looked back. Won the inter-college photography contest twice. Now I teach composition and lighting to students who want to level up.

name: Rohan Verma
bio: Mech student building robots and selling my old workshop tools. Hit me up for robotics collab.
story: Built a line-following robot for our annual project expo and caught the robotics bug. I now run informal weekend workshops for juniors on servo motors and control systems.

name: Sneha Patil
bio: Civil Engg student with a full set of surveying instruments available for rent. Serious about sustainable campus gear sharing.
story: My family owns construction equipment and I wanted to do something useful with the surveying instruments gathering dust. Now they help a dozen students every semester.

name: Karan Joshi
bio: Electronics mentor available for circuit design and PCB help. Also renting out my lab tools at fair prices.
story: Failed my first PCB design spectacularly — trace too thin, board shorted. Learned the hard way and now I save others from the same fate. Currently mentoring 4 juniors.

name: Aisha Khan
bio: Working on ML projects and always looking to borrow high-compute hardware. Happy to trade skills for gear access.
story: Got into ML in Sem 3 via a Kaggle competition — finished top 15% on my first attempt. Now I run a study group on applied machine learning for college students.

name: Dev Nair
bio: Got my calculators, lab coats, and science gear for a fraction of retail. Let's save money together.
story: Bought way too much stationery in Sem 1. Now I rent it out and fund my next semester's supplies.

name: Meera Pillai
bio: EE senior mentoring juniors on circuit analysis and measurement techniques. Oscilloscope rentals available.
story: Signal processing clicked for me when I visualized my first sine wave on an oscilloscope. Now I help Sem 2 students through the exact same 'aha' moment.
